♦ After 30 years of competition for the 'Denmark Pot' the trophy has returned home to Bill Couzens. We wonder if dear old Don Maclean, sadly no longer with us, ever dreamed in 1963 that the Pot he presented would be held in such high regard for so long.
The 32nd holding of the Darts Championship for the "Denmark Pot" took place at Belgrave Hall on December 2nd and once again Bill Couzens was the victor.
Again, as normal, Bill Couzens won it. That makes it the last five times in a row to go with the first three times the event was held in 1963-65 plus '69, '71 and '76.
Yet again Bill Couzens carried off the Denmark Pot for the Darts Championship. It was Bill's eleventh win in the 34 years that the event has been held.
